messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#P12345 - tenant="PeregrineAI" cluster="peregrine-reserved-7" metric=latency_p95 threshold=1500ms. Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/peregrine-reserved-latency

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert routed to oncall-sre. Auto-ack pending manual ack. Escalation timer: 10m.

maria (oncall-sre): ack. I'm looking. grabbing dashboard and logs now.

alice (product): any customer-facing errors reported? CS asking.

maria (oncall-sre): not seeing error spikes in API (5xx). Tail latency elevated for completion calls to tenant endpoint. P95 ~1700ms, p99 ~2.9s. Throughput steady.

ben (eng-runtime): pulling recent node metrics for peregrine-reserved-7. KV cache eviction rate jumped ~4x over last 7m. Disk io wait climbing on gpu-14. Logs show repeated slow kv fetches.

carol (eng-platform): can we shift a small slice of traffic to the fallback model variant (gpt-small-quant) for Peregrine while we triage? That should reduce token compute latency and ease queueing.

maria (oncall-sre): good idea. initiating a 10% reroute to fallback via control plane.

ops-bot: route-update: applied. reroute id=ru-7931, target="gpt-small-quant", percent=10, tenant="PeregrineAI".

ben (eng-runtime): verifying metrics after reroute... p95 down to ~920ms for affected requests routed to fallback. Overall p95 across tenant improved to ~1.2s (was 1.7s).

maria (oncall-sre): scaling reserved pool temporarily +2 GPUs on cluster peregrine-reserved-7 to relieve queueing. running scale command:

```
redwoodctl clusters scale --cluster peregrine-reserved-7 --add-gpus 2 --reason "oncall: mitigate p95 latency"
```

incident-bot: cluster scale job queued: job=scale-2415000000-01 ETA ~90s.

ben (eng-runtime): checking node gpu-14 kernel logs while scale coming up:

```
[ 2390.234] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 123456
[ 2390.235] CPU 3: Task xyz: ... blocked for 123ms
[ 2391.001] kvstore: eviction triggered, freed 64MB
```

ben (eng-runtime): looks like intermittent NVMe latency causing KV cache misses. not a full OOM but high IOwait.

carol (eng-platform): ops suggestion: enable prefix/KV prefetch for high-frequency keys for this tenant to reduce cold-fetches while we get nodes stabilized. I'll push a short-lived cache policy.

maria (oncall-sre): go ahead, push it and report back.

carol (eng-platform): applied prefix cache policy: `cache.policy=prefetch:tenants.peregrine.top10` for cluster peregrine-reserved-7. ops-bot confirmed.

ben (eng-runtime): after cache policy + reroute + scale-in-progress: p95 trending down to ~760ms for fallback traffic, overall tenant p95 ~880ms. error rate stable. CPU on new nodes normalizing.

cs-amber (customer-success): Peregrine CS: I'm drafting a quick note to the customer: "We saw elevated tail latency; we routed a portion of traffic to a fallback model and temporarily increased capacity. We're monitoring and will follow up in 30m." Shall I send?

alice (product): send the note. keep wording that there was latency but no errors. mention mitigation.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation timer updated. Next escalation will go to lead-sre in 10m if status not acknowledged-resolved.

maria (oncall-sre): scale job completed. new nodes joined: gpu-20,gpu-21. IO wait on original node decreased per node-metrics. continuing to monitor for 15m.

ben (eng-runtime): leaving some diagnostic commands here in thread for postmortem:

```
# snapshot of slow tasks
redwoodctl nodes top --cluster peregrine-reserved-7 --sort iowait --limit 20
redwoodctl kvstore metrics --tenant PeregrineAI --window 15m
```

maria (oncall-sre): handing this to night oncall jake with summary: mitigations applied (10% fallback, +2 GPUs, prefix cache enabled), p95 reduced ~60%. no 5xx spike, customer notified. leaving PD incident open until stable for 30m. @jake please ack and monitor.

jake (oncall-n2): ack. I'll watch dashboards and logs for next hour. thanks for the handoff.

maria (oncall-sre): adding notes to incident timeline and tagging runbook. planning a short postmortem to dig into NVMe latency cause and permanent cache policy for high-traffic tenants. :spiral_notepad:

ops-bot: incident-note: mitigations recorded (reroute=10%, scale=+2gpus, prefix_cache=enabled).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident status: acknowledged -> mitigated (monitoring). Escalation suspended.

maria (oncall-sre): marking thread as mitigated for now. will update if regressions appear. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Closing comment: keep an eye on runbook checklist items: storage health check, node reprovisioning, follow-up PM.
